images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of SOMA.Left: Representative questions from the three capability axes,Body Configuration,Motion Dynamics, andTemporal Reasoning, grounded in egocentric video and body motion. Right: Performance of representative MLLMs across the twelve SOMA tasks compared with human performance (5 annotators), highlighting a human–model gap. Note: performance normalized for visualization purposes.

Figure 2:SOMA Benchmark Taxonomy.SOMA comprises 12 tasks organized into three capability axes:Body Configuration,Motion DynamicsandTemporal Reasoning. We show the distribution of questions across tasks, together with a representative question for each task. See AppendixAfor more examples.
Figure 3:SOMA Data Construction Pipeline.We construct SOMA through task assignment, task-specific question generation, and quality control with blind-filtering and human validation.
